item.title: Astelight Shissouki
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: raiL-soft
  • 発売日: 2013-12-20
  • スコア: 6.95/10 (21 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 星継駅疾走軌
  • 英語名: Astelight Shissouki

あらすじ

In the midst of a deep fog shrouding a ‘station’ somewhere in the barren wasteland of an unknown world stood a strange giant machine. A forgotten legend has been revived: the train of the departed, containing people from the past, present and future. What things can they see while on this mysterious train? Why are they on this train and where is it heading? Will they be able to get off it safely?

item.title: Astelight Jourantan
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: raiL-soft
  • 発売日: 2012-07-20
  • スコア: 7.0/10 (29 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 星継駅擾乱譚
  • 英語名: Astelight Jourantan

别名

  • 星継駅擾乱譚

あらすじ

The past never fades—

the present stays unchanged—

the future won’t wait—

This is a story about ’the station.'

Once a relay point connecting stars, it’s now a massive hub on Earth’s surface for people who’ve forgotten its original purpose.

Still, generations change. One step at a time, ’the station’ gets its original function back, and people start rediscovering paths to the world of stars.

item.title: Hanachirutani Sanjinkou
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: raiL-soft
  • 発売日: 2011-11-25
  • スコア: 8.22/10 (69 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 花散峪山人考
  • 英語名: Hanachirutani Sanjinkou

あらすじ

This is a story of the past. One of the country’s olden days, which, however, passed not that long ago… A period between the two great wars. At this time, electric lights are shining and buildings of steel and cement are standing in the cities. On the other side, at the very same time, virgin forests, where no human has set foot, remain, and in their dense shadows, legends and tales are hidden.

  • 日本語名: 信天翁航海録
  • 英語名: Albatross Koukairoku

别名

  • Albatross Log

あらすじ

Aboard the Albatross is an odd captain and an equally crazy crew. With no map in hand, they sail to unknown islands, meet ghost ships and cross paths with giant monster fish. No one knows where they are heading… including the captain. But they still all stay together since there’s no other place for them.

item.title: Bengarachou Hakubutsushi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: raiL-soft
  • 発売日: 2009-07-24
  • スコア: 8.39/10 (109 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 紅殻町博物誌
  • 英語名: Bengarachou Hakubutsushi

别名

  • べんがらちょうはくぶつし

あらすじ

Tomohisa has some memory of his childhood. When he was a kid, he was often playing at some place near his house. But his parents don’t remember it. Tomohisa doesn’t remember it clearly, either. One day, he finds a notebook. It is about history and things happened at a small town. It’s just eccentric, so no one pays attention to it. But he knows who wrote it. It’s his uncle, who has been missing for years. The notebook includes a town he spent his childhood. He soon gets interested in the town and decides to visit there. Days later, he arrives at the town, but there are a lot of strange things and customs in the town. He finds various curious goods there and gradually gets to know a secret of the town and his past….

item.title: Kagerou Touryuuki
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: raiL-soft
  • 発売日: 2008-07-25
  • スコア: 8.48/10 (110 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 霞外籠逗留記
  • 英語名: Kagerou Touryuuki

别名

  • Kagerou Note

あらすじ

The main character regains his consciousness and finds himself being on a small boat. A girl on the boat tells him, “You’re going to the place you wished.” Where he arrives is an old hotel. While he stays there, he meets various girls. And as time passes, he needs to decide if he stays or leaves there…. Just when he makes up his mind, the girl appears and says to him, “You ran away and came here. Well, what’s your decision? Stay here or go back?” Which will he choose…?
